badge.extensionHint: The playbook supplies no template for this record; it is a platform extension (M0149).
badge.provisionalAr: Arabic title is a provisional translation

framework.title: Form tools: {{record}}
framework.intro: Extension fields with inline help, drafts, version history, comments and attachments of this record. A draft is not saved to the record until you save it.
framework.readOnly: You can read this record but not change it.

edit.intro: Change the fields below. Save a draft to keep your changes without changing the record; save to the record when you are ready.
edit.noExtensions: This form has no extension fields in the form version your transformation uses.
edit.saved: Saved to the record. Its new version is listed in the version history.
edit.draftSaved: Draft saved — not submitted. The record has not changed.
edit.draftOpen: You have an open draft of this record, saved {{at}}. It is not saved to the record yet.
edit.draftDiscarded: Draft discarded. The record has not changed.
edit.baseChanged: The record changed after you saved this draft (draft based on version {{base}}). Compare the values before you save.
edit.nothingChanged: Nothing to save: no field differs from the record.

typeHint.currency: An amount with at most two decimals.
typeHint.percentage: A percentage, for example 12%. It is stored as a fraction (12% = 0.12).
typeHint.reference: The ID of a record in this transformation.
typeHint.attachment: Evidence IDs of this transformation, separated by commas.
typeHint.calculated: Calculated when the record is read; it cannot be entered.

history.caption: Versions of this record, oldest first
history.empty: No version is recorded for this record yet.

comments.label: Comment
comments.noPermission: You can read comments but not post them.
comments.hint: 1 to 4000 characters. Comments cannot be edited or deleted after posting.

attachments.caption: Evidence attached to this record
attachments.chooseHint: Only evidence of this transformation can be attached.
attachments.reasonHint: 3 to 1000 characters. The attachment stays in history as removed.
attachments.empty: No evidence is attached to this record.
attachments.noEvidence: This transformation has no evidence to attach yet.

export.title: Export {{form}}
export.intro: Exports every record of this form in this transformation, with its extension fields. Unknown values are marked, never shown as 0.
export.caption: Export preview (first {{count}} rows)
export.empty: This form has no records in this transformation, so the export has no rows.

builder.title: Form builder
builder.intro: The native forms of the Playbook Studio. Source columns are protected: you may relabel them, add help and mark them required, but never delete them or change their type. Extension fields are added in a draft of the forms configuration and take effect for transformations when it is published.
builder.caption: Native forms

schema.versionHint: A published version is read only. Choose an open draft to add or change fields.
schema.draftNeeded: To change fields, create a draft of the forms configuration in the Playbook Studio, then choose it here.
schema.readOnlyVersion: This version is published and cannot be changed.
schema.editableDraft: Draft — editing. Changes apply to transformations only after the draft is published.
schema.caption: Fields of this form
schema.label: Label
schema.removeBody: The field is marked removed in this draft. Stored values stay in history.
schema.removeSourceBody: Source columns cannot be deleted. The server refuses this request; you may relabel the column or add help instead.
schema.fieldKeyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter; not a source column key.
schema.optionsHint: One option per line as value|English label|Arabic label.
schema.expressionHint: Uses the numeric fields of this form as variables.
schema.saved: Field saved in the draft. Publish the draft in the Playbook Studio to apply it.
schema.removed: Field marked removed in the draft.
schema.noExtensionsAllowed: This form does not take extension fields.
schema.planned: This form is not available in this release.
